name: 走れメロス(Z2 Standard・学習コーナー)

p_d53f16b17f.sentence: Before Melos could say anything, his friend held out his hands.
p_d53f16b17f.next: He was ready for the guards to put chains on him.

p_45032bf2da.sentence: He fought his way up and caught a branch.
p_45032bf2da.next: At last, he pulled himself onto the other side.

p_a31a016ed7.sentence: “And I almost lost my trust in you,” his friend said.
p_a31a016ed7.prev: “I almost left you to die,” Melos said quietly.
p_a31a016ed7.next: They held each other close in the evening light.

p_79616dc6e4.sentence: I promise to come back here to die.”
p_79616dc6e4.prev: Let me go to her wedding.
p_79616dc6e4.next: “Return before sunset on the third day,” the ruler said.

p_edeec723d2.sentence: Before sunrise on the third day, Melos started back toward the city.
p_edeec723d2.prev: He wanted to keep that happy sound in his memory.
p_edeec723d2.next: When he reached the river, the bridge was gone.

p_f8e0ef8480.sentence: Later, three men blocked his way.
p_f8e0ef8480.prev: At last, he pulled himself onto the other side.

p_063cc63675.sentence: But for a moment, saving himself seemed easier than standing up.
p_063cc63675.next: Then he remembered his friend’s hands, ready for the chains.

p_23769897f7.sentence: Slowly, he got to his knees.
p_23769897f7.next: Then he stood and started walking again.

p_5f55d09a51.sentence: Melos stood before the city’s ruler.
p_5f55d09a51.next: “You are afraid of people, so you kill them.
